semiconductor_relevance: High — Seiwa Optical specializes in optical solutions and equipment for inspection and measurement in the semiconductor industry.
summary: Seiwa Optical Co., Ltd. provides customizable optical solutions for machine vision, inspection, and industrial processing, with a strong focus on the semiconductor sector. Their offerings include inline and offline equipment for exposure, inspection, and laser processing, tailored to meet specific customer needs.
capabilities: Inline and offline exposure equipment for patterning
Inspection equipment for alignment and defect review
Laser equipment for welding and processing

regional_presence.Japan: Seiwa Optical has three manufacturing facilities in Japan, focusing on the production of optical components.
